items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.snippet: Price targets have been cut across RBC, BofA, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Mizuho, UBS and Argus on softer lithium sentiment and recent spot price weakness. Truist, Scotiabank and Argus cite cost efficiencies, capital discipline and resilient lithium demand.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year but well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027; balance sheet solid and management is reducing cos

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital lowered its price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating, lowering lithium company targets after recent spot price weakness while viewing the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized a tight lithium market on strong EV and stationary storage demand with supply lagging. Albemarle maintained its 2026 outlook, expects the high end of scenario ranges, and achieved $100 million in run-rate savings year to date.
